title: Frontend Developer Intern
text:
Peacock Studio designs booking apps for clinics in Pune and Nagpur.

Role overview
You will build user interfaces with React and TypeScript, turning Figma designs into accessible, responsive pages.

What we're looking for
- Solid HTML and CSS, including flexbox and grid
- Hands-on React (hooks, state, effects)
- TypeScript or modern JavaScript
- Basic Git workflow

Good to have
- Next.js
- Tailwind CSS
- Writing component tests
